Give each active worktree its own writable object directory. Central reusable outputs must be keyed by Gecko/comm revisions, build configuration, platform, architecture, and artifact overrides, and published only after completion; use shared `sccache` with `SCCACHE_BASEDIRS` to reuse compiler results while rebuilding privately.
